instructions: Copy this file, replace every absolute source/configuration path and artifact ID, then pass --cases YOUR_FILE.json.
Inputs are copied without .git, .weld, deps or _build; symlinks and special files are refused. Original consumer checkouts are never modified.

Each configs entry supplies a relative manifest target inside the disposable copy. Optional manifest_source supplies a benchmark-specific manifest to copy to that target; its workspace root must be relative to the target location.
The exact baseline SHA selects baseline; the checkpoint SHA selects checkpoint when provided, otherwise current; other refs select current. A ref name or full commit SHA can also be a configs key.
Every selected operation runs once cold and five times warm. Verify executes the real qualifier and may need network access, installed native tools and declared project prerequisites.
Full/live force materialization on all six samples. Full_cache/live_cache retain state, measure cold population once, and require all five warm samples to be actual validated cache hits.

Docs and native compile command durations inside verification are recorded separately when instrumentable. Optional operations docs and native run explicit commands in the generated project; provide docs_command/native_command and arrange declared prerequisites when using them.
Run mix weld setup first in the Weld checkout. Run on the same idle host and pinned Elixir/OTP/Hex toolchain. Never interpret this script as publication authorization.
